# glossary

The one register of this project's names — a register, not an encyclopaedia: it confirms what a name already says and is never needed to decode it; the rules a name obeys are Skills, and the derivations a human reads are a methodology's. *The repository shows the destination, not the road*: the crawler reads a file against the register where the files matrix marks it, and gates nothing.

## Naming

- `GLOSSARY-NAME-IS-THE-REGISTERED-ONE`
  - Description: One concept has one canonical term, and each surface — code, artifacts, the interface — one registered form of it, reused on that surface with no second project meaning.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: Each registered surface form reused consistently on its surface; no local synonym and no second project meaning.
  - Exception: A name imposed by an external library or protocol at its own boundary, explicitly named in the glossary row.
- `GLOSSARY-THE-CONCEPT-CELL-SAYS-WHAT-THE-NAME-MEANS`
  - Description: A register row confirms its name: a term standard in the field — `fold`, `purge`, `embargo`, out-of-sample, Sharpe — stands in the field's own sense, and for every other name the `concept` cell states what it denotes.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`
  - Expected: Every row's `concept` saying what the name denotes, a standard term's in the field's sense, so a reader who opens the register finds a confirmation, never a decoding.
  - Exception: none

## Validation and folds

- a fold — one chronological segment of the research window; `F1`, the first, is trained on and never evaluated
  - Code: `fold`, `fold_id`
  - Artifact key: `fold_2` … `fold_5`
  - Ui label: `F2` … `F5`
  - Never: split, period, chunk
  - External vocabulary: machine learning (cross-validation)
- the segment boundaries
  - Code: `FOLD_BOUNDS_UTC` (a CONFIGURABLES record), `FOLD_BOUNDS_MS`, `fold_bounds()`
  - Never: split_bounds
- the validation folds — the folds used for the data-driven selection of model hyper-parameters, the entry edge threshold and, once a set is promoted, the feature set; every state the serpentine search compares is scored on them
  - Code: `VALIDATION_FOLD_IDS`
  - Artifact key: `validation`
  - Ui label: `F2`–`F4`
  - Never: test folds, CV folds, "the folds that choose every parameter"
- the final holdout — the fold that is only ever evaluated, never selected on
  - Code: `FINAL_HOLDOUT_FOLD_ID`
  - Artifact key: `final_holdout`, `final_holdout_fold_id`
  - Ui label: `F5 — final holdout (out-of-sample)`
  - Never: test, test set, locked test, final OOS
  - External vocabulary: machine learning (holdout)
- the evaluated block of a fold, and which one a prediction belongs to
  - Code: the prefix `oos_` — `oos_fold_id`, `oos_start`, `oos_end`
  - Artifact key: `oos_fold_id` (a column of the family `oos_predictions`)
  - Ui label: out-of-sample
  - Never: test block, test period
  - External vocabulary: machine learning (out-of-sample)
- the purge — dropping training events that overlap the evaluated block
  - Code: `training_set()` — `event_end_ts <= oos_start_ms`, the event's end being exclusive
  - Ui label: purged (the asset README's fold geometry)
  - Never: gap, buffer
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (purged cross-validation)
- the embargo — a forced wait after the evaluated block, of width zero here: forward chaining needs none, so no identifier carries it
  - Never: cooldown, post-test embargo
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (purged cross-validation)
- the warm-up — the bars of the top timeframe consumed before the first decision is allowed, read off the catalogue: the longest warm-up any definition needs
  - Code: `WARMUP_TOP_TIMEFRAME_BARS`, `WARMUP_END_MS`; `term_warmup_bars()`, `definition_warmup_bars()`
  - Artifact key: `warmup_excluded_decision_count`; `warmup` (`top_timeframe_bars`, `end_utc`) of the catalogue block, `warmup_bars` of a catalogue definition; `warmup_top_timeframe_bars`, `warmup_end_ms` of the contract
  - Ui label: warm-up excluded; warm-up (bars); `warm-up: <n> bars of <timeframe> · first decision <UTC>` in the register box
  - Never: burn-in; a timeframe token in the name, which lies once the register grows; a warm-up written down beside the catalogue

## Market object

- the external minute-bar format the raw store is byte-compatible with
  - Code: QuantConnect Lean — `module_data/lean.py`
  - Artifact key: — (the raw tree only)
  - Ui label: Lean ZIPs (the page's subtitle)
  - Never: QC, quantconnect-format, `lean` lower-case mid-sentence; a project-cased spelling of its tree
  - External vocabulary: QuantConnect Lean
- the canonical series — the studied series, and the only series below the ingest boundary
  - Code: `ohlcv_1m_canonical` and its aggregates, the family `bars`; `ohlcv_1m_canonical_parquet()`, `bars_parquet()`
  - Artifact key: — (the families `ohlcv_1m_canonical` and `bars`; no copy of the series is published)
  - Ui label: canonical dataset
  - Never: fused series, index, blended price
- the symbol — the venues' name for an asset, its ticker then the quote asset; which asset a partition holds is its `ticker=` segment, never a column
  - Code: `config.symbol(ticker)`, `QUOTE_ASSET`; the partition `ticker=<TICKER>/` of `partition_dir()`
  - Artifact key: `symbol` — a key of data_status.json only
  - Never: a `symbol` or a ticker column in any family, a `WHERE symbol = …` predicate, a `GROUP BY symbol`
  - External vocabulary: Binance, Bybit (the symbol); Hive (the `ticker=` segment)
- the timeframe hierarchy — the register's timeframes, finest first, a CONFIGURABLES record: one partition of `bars` and one of `catalogue` each, the coarsest the trend gate's, and the contract and the decision grid built from it
  - Code: `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES`, `module_features/config.py`
  - Artifact key: `catalogue.timeframes` — `timeframe`, `duration_ms`, `bars_per_day`, `ratio_to_lower`, `slot`; the contract's `timeframes`
  - Ui label: each token, finest first, in the register box of the catalogue frame
  - Never: levels, LEVELS, a hierarchy derived from a dict, a second list of timeframes anywhere
- the decision timeframe — the grid the decisions, the labels and the strategy stand on, a CONFIGURABLES record beside the hierarchy
  - Code: `DECISION_TIMEFRAME`
  - Artifact key: `catalogue.decision_timeframe`; the contract's `decision_timeframe`
  - Ui label: the decision timeframe (the register box)
  - Never: DECISION_TF, `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES[0]` read where the record is meant
- the token duration and slot — how long one bar of a token lasts and the token's file-name slot, both read off the number and the unit
  - Code: `timeframe_duration_ms()`, `timeframe_slot()`, `TIMEFRAME_UNIT_MS`, `TIMEFRAME_SLOT_FIELDS`, `TIMEFRAME_UNIT_SLOT_FIELD` — the unit's duration, the five slots of the sorting standard and the field a unit fills; `TIMEFRAME_DURATION_MS` and `TIMEFRAME_SLOT`, the two read off the hierarchy
  - Artifact key: `duration_ms`, `slot`
  - Never: TF_MS, a duration or a slot written by hand per token
- the barrier timeframe — the timeframe whose last closed bar sets the barrier width of a label, an entry of the hierarchy and the label's own CONFIGURABLES record
  - Code: `LABEL_BARRIER_TRUE_RANGE_TIMEFRAME`, `module_ml/config.py`
  - Never: its token as a literal in a query or an assert; `LABEL_BARRIER_ATR_TIMEFRAME`
- a venue — a data provider, above the ingest boundary only
  - Code: `binance` / `bybit` in `module_data`, in tier order in `SOURCE_VENUES`
  - Artifact key: `source_venues`, `venues.*`, `source_share_pct_by_venue.*`
  - Ui label: the provider's name, one frame each under *Raw sources, one per provider*; `providers` in the Pipeline box
  - Never: venue or exchange used below ingest
  - External vocabulary: Binance, Bybit REST
- the source — the provider a canonical minute came from
  - Code: `source`, `source_switch_count`
  - Artifact key: `source_switch_count`; `source` is a column of the family `ohlcv_1m_canonical`, published only as `source_share_pct_by_venue` and the forward-filled count
  - Ui label: one share column per provider, named for it, in the tier order of `source_venues`
- a minute with no observed trade
  - Code: `volume = 0`, `zero_volume`
  - Artifact key: `zero_volume_bars`; `zero_volume` is a column of the family `ohlcv_1m_canonical`
  - Ui label: zero-vol
  - Never: carried-forward price (true only of forward-filled minutes)
- a synthesised continuity minute
  - Code: `source = 'ffill'`
  - Artifact key: `ffill_bars`
  - Ui label: ffill
  - Never: gap, missing bar
- the quality columns — the validity and divergence columns of the canonical series, beside OHLCV
  - Code: `binance_valid`, `bybit_valid`, `rel_divergence`
  - Artifact key: — (columns of the family `ohlcv_1m_canonical`; `rel_divergence` is published only as `relative_divergence_p99` / `relative_divergence_max`; `<venue>_valid` is what `invalid_row_count` counts the failures of)
  - Never: signal, feature

## Event and sample

- the moment a decision may be taken — a bar close of the decision timeframe
  - Code: `decision_ts`
  - Artifact key: `decision_ts`
  - Never: signal time
- the candidate entry minute after the decision — an entry is permitted here, not guaranteed
  - Code: `entry_ts`
  - Artifact key: `entry_ts`
  - Never: fill time, first tradable minute
- the canonical open of that minute
  - Code: `entry_price`
  - Artifact key: `entry_price`
  - Never: `p0` as an identifier (`P₀` stays in the equations)
- the take-profit price of a long, the stop of a short — the label's own, symmetric barrier
  - Code: `upper_barrier`
  - Artifact key: `upper_barrier`
  - Ui label: upper_barrier (the asset README's exits); upper (the Strategy view's exits)
  - Never: `upper` as the barrier's identifier, ceiling, band
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (triple-barrier method)
- the stop of a long, the take-profit of a short
  - Code: `lower_barrier`
  - Artifact key: `lower_barrier`
  - Ui label: lower_barrier (the asset README's exits); lower (the Strategy view's exits)
  - Never: `lower` as the barrier's identifier, floor, band
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (triple-barrier method)
- the vertical barrier — the label's horizon, a duration token of the timeframe grammar, turned into minutes in one place
  - Code: `label_horizon` of `START_BY_COORDINATE_DEFAULT` (the frozen default), `HORIZON_TOKEN_MINUTES`; `barriers_from()`, `load_barriers()` in `module_ml/dataset.py`, which carry it as `horizon_minutes`
  - Artifact key: `label_horizon` — a key of `<TICKER>_barriers.json`, of a trial and of the profile's `grid_by_coordinate`
  - Ui label: — (no page shows it; the asset README says `<minutes>-minute horizon`)
  - Never: HORIZON_BARS, W, H; a horizon in minutes where the token belongs; a second place that resolves a token; `LABEL_HORIZON`, `LABEL_HORIZON_MINUTES`
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (triple-barrier method)
- the exclusive end of the event
  - Code: `event_end_ts`
  - Artifact key: `event_end_ts`
  - Never: exit time
- the price that closes the event
  - Code: `exit_reference_price`
  - Artifact key: `exit_reference_price`
  - Never: exit_ref
- the event resolution — how the event ended
  - Code: `event_resolution`
  - Artifact key: `event_resolution`, `exit_counts.*`
  - Ui label: upper_barrier / lower_barrier / vertical / ambiguous (the asset README's exits); `exits: upper/lower/vertical/ambiguous` in the Strategy view
  - Never: reason, exit_reason
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (triple-barrier method)
- the label's barrier multiplier — the multiple of the barrier timeframe's true range, smoothed by its recursive mean, that the label's barriers stand at; a coordinate of the serpentine search and a key of the promoted geometry
  - Code: `label_barrier_true_range_multiplier` of `START_BY_COORDINATE_DEFAULT` (the frozen default); `LABEL_BARRIER_TRUE_RANGE_SMOOTHING_PERIOD_BARS`, the smoothing
  - Artifact key: `label_barrier_true_range_multiplier`
  - Ui label: — (no page shows it; the features terminal names the key as a coordinate)
  - Never: a multiplier written per side, which the label never has; `atr_barrier_multiplier`, `ATR_BARRIER_MULTIPLIER`
  - External vocabulary: technical analysis (Wilder's true range)
- the four resolutions
  - Code: `EVENT_RESOLUTION_{UPPER_BARRIER, LOWER_BARRIER, VERTICAL, AMBIGUOUS}`, named by `EVENT_RESOLUTION_NAMES`
  - Artifact key: `event_resolution`
  - Never: bare 1 / −1 / 0 / 9
- the entry minute traded at all — knowable at `entry_ts`, may gate an entry
  - Code: `entry_observable`
  - Artifact key: `entry_observable`; its complement is counted as `unobservable_entry_count`
  - Ui label: unobservable entry
  - Never: tradable, valid entry
- label validity — the event can be classified, knowable only afterwards, so it never gates an entry
  - Code: `label_valid`
  - Artifact key: `label_valid`; its complement is counted as `ambiguous_event_count`
  - Ui label: ambiguous
  - Never: masked
- the supervised population: both of the above
  - Code: `sample_valid`
  - Artifact key: `trainable_row_count`, `trainable_row_pct`
  - Ui label: trainable rows
  - Never: valid rows
- the average uniqueness weight — how little an event overlaps its neighbours within one population, measured after the purge
  - Code: `average_uniqueness_weight()`, `train_weight` / `scoring_weight`
  - Never: `weight` as a Y column, class weight
  - External vocabulary: López de Prado (sample weights)
- the epoch-millisecond suffix — `_ts` on the three event columns, a contract with the partitions on disk; `_ms` on every other epoch-millisecond name
  - Code: `decision_ts`, `entry_ts`, `event_end_ts`; `timestamp_ms`, `WARMUP_END_MS`, `FOLD_BOUNDS_MS`
  - Artifact key: `decision_ts`, `entry_ts`, `event_end_ts` — columns of the family `labels`, `decision_ts` also of `catalogue` and `oos_predictions`; `timestamp_ms` of the `ohlcv_1m_*` families and of `bars`; `warmup_end_ms` of the contract
  - Never: `_ts` on a new epoch-millisecond key or on a UTC string

## Signal and strategy

- the directional edge — the model's directional lean, `p_long − p_short`
  - Code: `directional_probability_edge`
  - Ui label: — (no page shows it)
  - Never: `edge` as a code name
- the entry edge threshold — how much lean a signal must carry to be traded
  - Code: `entry_edge_threshold` (τ in the equations)
  - Artifact key: `entry_edge_threshold`
  - Ui label: τ (entry edge threshold); entry edge threshold (τ); τ alone in the PROPOSALS header, spelled out in its foot
  - Never: `tau` as an identifier; τ alone at its first use in a document or on a page
- the threshold grid — the points the entry edge threshold is chosen among
  - Code: `ENTRY_EDGE_THRESHOLD_GRID` (a CONFIGURABLES record)
  - Never: TAU_GRID
- the threshold constraint — met when some threshold on the grid cleared the trade floor in every validation fold
  - Code: `entry_edge_threshold_constraint_met`
  - Artifact key: `entry_edge_threshold_constraint_met`
  - Ui label: `constraint met` (yes / fallback); `!` beside a fallback threshold
  - Never: `tau_ok`, a name that says a constraint without saying which
- the trade floor — the least trades a validation fold must hold for a number measured on it to count: the threshold is chosen among the grid points clearing it in every fold, a study's gate reads it fold by fold, and the serpentine search's gate refuses a state whose threshold fell back below it
  - Code: `MINIMUM_TRADES_PER_VALIDATION_FOLD` (a CONFIGURABLES record)
  - Never: MIN_TRADES; a floor read twice, in two places, with two values
- the trend agreement — how many timeframes must agree with the side
  - Code: `MINIMUM_AGREEING_TREND_TIMEFRAMES` (a CONFIGURABLES record), `agreeing_trend_timeframe_count`
  - Artifact key: `minimum_agreeing_trend_timeframes`
  - Ui label: at least `n` of `m` timeframes agree — `n` from `ml_status.json`, `m` the hierarchy's length from `features_status.json`
  - Never: AGREE_MIN, n_agree, level
- the trade barriers — where a trade leaves: the take-profit and the stop as multiples of the same smoothed true range the label's barrier stands at, the label's own half-widths rescaled — above a long and below it, mirrored for a short
  - Code: `take_profit_true_range_multiplier`, `stop_loss_true_range_multiplier`, `trade_barriers()`
  - Artifact key: `take_profit_true_range_multiplier`, `stop_loss_true_range_multiplier`
  - Ui label: — (no page shows them; the features terminal names the two keys as coordinates)
  - Never: a label barrier per side (the label stays symmetric, so the model learns a direction); a trade exit derived from one recovered sigma, which misses the lower barrier by a unit in the last place; `take_profit_atr_multiplier`, `stop_loss_atr_multiplier`
- the backtest — replaying the strategy over the canonical price path
  - Code: `backtest()`
  - Artifact key: `<TICKER>_strategy_evaluation.json`
  - Ui label: STRATEGY (the asset's frame); Strategy (the view)
  - Never: live execution, exchange execution
- the execution cost charged on entry and on exit
  - Code: `EXECUTION_COST_RATE_PER_TRADE_SIDE` (a CONFIGURABLES record)
  - Artifact key: `execution_cost_rate_per_trade_side`
  - Ui label: cost per side
  - Never: costs_per_side, cost_per_side, fees

## Counts

- the decision count — decisions on the decision grid after the warm-up whose horizon still fits the research window: the labelled population, short of the catalogue's grid by the dropped tail
  - Code: `decision_count`
  - Artifact key: `decision_count`
  - Ui label: decisions
  - Never: rows, `n`
- the scored row count — rows a fold's metrics are computed on
  - Code: `scored_row_count`
  - Artifact key: `scored_row_count`
  - Ui label: scored rows; scored (holdout)
  - Never: `n`
- the training row count and the purged event count — rows the model is fitted on, and the events purged before them
  - Code: `training_row_count`, `purged_event_count`
  - Artifact key: `training_row_count`, `purged_event_count` — per fold, in `segments` of `<TICKER>_model_evaluation.json`
  - Ui label: trained on / purged (the asset README's fold geometry)
  - Never: n_train, n_purged
- the window row count — rows in a prediction window
  - Code: `window_row_count`
  - Artifact key: `window_row_count` — per fold, in `segments` of `<TICKER>_model_evaluation.json`
  - Ui label: window (the asset README's fold geometry)
  - Never: n_window
- the trade count — trades a fold produced
  - Code: `trade_count`
  - Artifact key: `trade_count`
  - Ui label: trades
  - Never: n_trades
- the trial count — the points one study draws, the states a serpentine search's ledger holds, and per loop the fits that search spent: its ledger lines and its studies' draws, counted once at a round boundary and copied by every reader
  - Code: `HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH_TRIAL_COUNT`, `HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH_STARTUP_TRIAL_COUNT` (CONFIGURABLES records), `trial_count`, `trial_count_by_loop`
  - Artifact key: `trial_count`, `trial_count_by_loop`
  - Ui label: trials; trials by loop (the features terminal)
  - Never: `n_trials` beyond Optuna's own call
  - External vocabulary: Optuna (a trial of a study)
- a round of the serpentine search — `ROUND_SCHEDULE` read in order, one line per expansion it makes; a profile searches the loops it names and the round skips the rest
  - Code: `ROUND_SCHEDULE`, `round_count`; `round` of a trial
  - Artifact key: `round_count`, `round`
  - Ui label: rounds
  - Never: iterations; a round of boosting, which `num_boost_round` already names

## Data quality (data_status.json)

- a scan alias — the name a column of a data-quality scan carries: the key it becomes when the report publishes it, else what the scan measured
  - Code: `VENUE_SCAN`, `CANONICAL_SCAN`, `SOURCE_SWITCH_SCAN`, `CANONICAL_RUN_SCAN` in `module_data/status.py`, the writer of data_status.json; `distinct_timestamp_count`, `first_timestamp_ms`, `<venue>_source_count` stay inside a scan
  - Artifact key: the published key itself
  - Never: an alias renamed on its way into the payload; an alias named for the share or the text it becomes
- the two kinds a measured number can be, and the rule for reading them — an invariant has one correct value, zero; an observation has no threshold anyone can name and is read against its previous reading, on the data views the previous provider's: after a change of provider the invariants must still be zero and the observations are expected to move
  - Artifact key: — (a property of each key of the two tables: `duplicate_count`, `invalid_row_count` and `ohlc_violation_count` are the invariants, every other number an observation)
  - Ui label: a marked column, its cells of the class `invariant`; *invariant* and *observation* in the tab's foot
  - Never: a colour for a magnitude; an invariant named a check, a gate or a guard; an observation called a failure
- the row count — minutes a venue printed, or the canonical grid holds
  - Artifact key: `row_count`
  - Ui label: rows (`canonical rows` on the Pipeline tab)
  - Never: n
- the gap count — grid minutes a venue did not print, over the whole window or since its first observation
  - Artifact key: `gap_count`, `gap_count_after_first_observation`
  - Ui label: gaps; gaps (since first obs.)
- the duplicate count — rows a venue printed beyond one per minute, the surplus and not the minutes it fell on
  - Artifact key: `duplicate_count`
  - Ui label: dups
  - Never: duplicates
- the OHLC violation count — candles whose OHLC ordering is broken, on the canonical series
  - Artifact key: `ohlc_violation_count`
  - Ui label: ohlc bad
  - Never: ohlc_violations
- the invalid rows — venue rows `ingest.py` will not join, the OHLC-intact predicate having failed on a value and not only on the ordering
  - Code: `OHLC_INTACT_PREDICATE` of `module_data/ingest.py`, imported by `module_data/status.py`
  - Artifact key: `invalid_row_count`
  - Ui label: invalid
  - Never: rejected, dropped; a second copy of the predicate
- a venue's last printed close, the one dimensioned number the snapshot carries
  - Artifact key: `last_close`
  - Ui label: last close
  - Never: `price`, `px`
- the source switch count — minutes whose source differs from the previous minute
  - Artifact key: `source_switch_count`
  - Ui label: switches
  - Never: source_switches
- the largest 1m move at a switch / anywhere on the canonical series
  - Artifact key: `max_abs_return_at_switch`, `max_abs_return_1m`
  - Ui label: max |ret| at switch / max |ret| 1m
  - Never: `*_ret_*`
- a venue's first and last printed minute
  - Artifact key: `first_observation_utc`, `last_observation_utc`
  - Ui label: first / last
  - Never: `first_ts` (a `_ts` is epoch ms)
- the data window
  - Artifact key: `window_start_utc`
  - Ui label: window
  - Never: `window_start`; a window end, which the newest `last_observation_utc` already is
- the bars of a kind — bars of one kind inside a bar or a series, a unit and not a bare count
  - Artifact key: `ffill_bars`, `zero_volume_bars`, `flat_bars`
  - Ui label: ffill (`ffill bars` on the Pipeline tab) / zero-vol / flat
  - Never: `n_ffill`
- the repeated candle count — canonical minutes repeating the previous candle verbatim while volume was printed: a feed frozen on its last bar, which no flatness count sees
  - Artifact key: `repeated_candle_count`
  - Ui label: repeated
  - Never: `dupes` (a duplicate is a repeated timestamp, not a repeated candle)
- the shares — the coverage of the grid and each venue's share of the canonical minutes, in per cent
  - Artifact key: `coverage_pct`, `source_share_pct_by_venue` (one share per venue, keyed by it)
  - Ui label: coverage / one column per provider, the tier order of `source_venues`; real-data share (the Pipeline tab's arithmetic)
  - Never: ratio without `_pct`; a `<venue>_pct` key per venue; a share the page can divide out of two published counts (the ffill and real-data shares are its arithmetic)
- the relative divergence — cross-venue close divergence over the canonical series
  - Artifact key: `relative_divergence_p99`, `relative_divergence_max`
  - Ui label: rel. divergence p99 / max (`max` alone on the page, under the p99 it is read against)
  - Never: `rdiv`; a mean, which the bulk decides and no reading uses

## Metrics

- the prior log-loss — log-loss of the weighted training class prior
  - Code: `prior_logloss`
  - Artifact key: `prior_logloss`
  - Ui label: prior log-loss (`prior LL` in a cross-section header)
  - Never: baseline
- the model log-loss — log-loss of the model on the evaluated block
  - Code: `model_logloss`
  - Artifact key: `model_logloss`
  - Ui label: model log-loss (`model LL` in a cross-section header)
  - Never: loss
- the relative log-loss skill — information beyond the prior, `1 − model / prior`, the model's own measure per fold: reported beside every state the serpentine search scores, and selected on by nothing
  - Code: `relative_logloss_skill`
  - Artifact key: `relative_logloss_skill`
  - Ui label: skill (`rel. skill`, `val skill F<n>`, `mean val skill`, `holdout skill` in the tables)
  - Never: accuracy, edge
- HPO — the search for model hyper-parameters, and the stage that runs it: a function of X, Y and the frozen constants, drawing no point to start from
  - Code: HPO — `module_ml/hpo.py`, `make ml-hpo`; `search_hyperparameters()`
  - Artifact key: `hyperparameter_search_result`
  - Never: tuning, optimisation, autoML; a derived artifact that reads its own last value; `HPO` spelled out mid-document after its first use; `search` alone for the serpentine search
  - External vocabulary: Optuna (the TPE sampler)
- the serpentine search — a beam over the coordinates of a state, scored on the validation folds under the profile a hand drafted; a hand's research outside the chain, one turn per call, its selection overfitting bounded and exposed, never absent: every fold must agree, a move must clear the noise margin, and the trial count stands on the page beside the proposals
  - Code: `module_features/sub_module_serpentine_search/`: `serpentine_search.py`, `coordinate_barrier.py`, `coordinate_feature_set.py`, `promote.py`; `make features-serpentine-search` — per asset a turn, then `ml-score` and a turn again while the turn leaves a question — and its detached twin `tmux-features-serpentine-search` in the tmux session `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_SESSION`, one asset per session
  - Artifact key: `serpentine_search` (a block of each asset of features_status.json), `<TICKER>_serpentine_search.json`
  - Ui label: serpentine search
  - Never: the coordinate search, its name while `module_ml` held it; feature-set search (one of its loops, not the serpentine search); feature selection (as a name), optimisation, the search (HPO's word); "no overfitting"
- a turn — one call of the serpentine search: it reads where the serpentine search stands, carries it as far as the answers on disk allow, and leaves the next question or a converged state
  - Code: `turn()` in `module_features/sub_module_serpentine_search/serpentine_search.py`; `make features-serpentine-turn`
  - Ui label: `features-serpentine-turn` in the features terminal's menu
  - Never: a step, an iteration, a tick; a turn that asks two questions; a cursor, a journal or a lock recording where a turn stopped — the ledger and the state file are the record
- a coordinate — one axis the serpentine search moves along, with its own generator of moves; the state is the ordered dict of them and a trial carries the whole of it
  - Code: `candidates_of()`, `ROUND_SCHEDULE`, `state_key()`, `theta()`; `BARRIER_COORDINATE_NAMES`; the generators `moves()` of `coordinate_barrier.py` and `coordinate_feature_set.py`; `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_LOOP_BARRIER`, `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_LOOP_FEATURE_SET`, `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_LOOP_HPO`
  - Artifact key: `loop` = `barrier` / `feature_set` / `hpo`, and the coordinate's own keys in a trial
  - Ui label: coordinate (the features terminal's draft)
  - Never: a dimension, an axis, a knob; a coordinate named inside `serpentine_search.py`
- a family — one expansion of the beam, and one line of `ROUND_SCHEDULE`: the loop it belongs to and its own name, read in the table's order, each seeded by the beam the line before it left
  - Code: `ROUND_SCHEDULE`
  - Artifact key: `family` = `trade` / `label` / `forward` / `backward` / `study`
  - Ui label: family (the features terminal's path table)
  - Never: a stage, a step, a phase; a family whose order a profile chooses; a table family — a different meaning
- a family pass — the states one family offers, scored in one call of the evaluator; the unit the boundary between the serpentine search and the evaluator carries
  - Code: `score_results()`, `hpo_results()` in `module_ml/score.py`
  - Artifact key: `states` of a request, `results` of a response
  - Never: a trial as the unit of a call, which would be one process per state; a pass spanning two families
- the beam — the states a family leaves: the best distinct of its gate-cleared children and of the parents they came from, `top_beam(children + beam)` after each family, at most `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_BEAM_WIDTH`; width 1 is one champion moved one move at a time
  - Code: `SERPENTINE_SEARCH_BEAM_WIDTH` (a CONFIGURABLES record), `top_beam()`
  - Artifact key: `beam` (trial indices)
  - Never: a population, a frontier; a beam holding one state twice
  - External vocabulary: beam search
- the research path — the expansions the serpentine search accepted, in order, each naming its trial by index
  - Code: `path_entry()`
  - Artifact key: `path`, each `round`, `loop`, `family`, `trial_index`, `beam`, `move`
  - Ui label: the path table of the features terminal
  - Never: a history, a log, a trace; a path holding a move that was scored and rejected; a trial's skill or path copied into the state
- the state a move is measured against — its parent in the beam, not the champion of the loop
  - Code: `parent_trial_index`
  - Artifact key: `parent_trial_index`
  - Never: the champion, where the parent is meant
- the selection rule — the one rule every choice reads: a child clears the gate by the validation path's growth rate beyond the noise margin and by every fold's Calmar ratio; the path's growth rate ranks the beam and is the objective of the threshold's choice and of a study
  - Code: `SELECTION_FOLD_MEASURE`, `fold_objective()`, `state_objective()`, `is_gate_cleared()`, `ranking_key()`, `strategy.selection_score()`, `strategy.SELECTION_SCORE_KEY`

  - Ui label: trial
  - Never: candidate (as a key), step; a trial carrying only the coordinate that moved; the serpentine search's state rewritten per trial
- the mean validation skill — the mean over the validation folds of a trial's relative log-loss skill

  - Artifact key: `mean_relative_logloss_skill`

  - Artifact key: `champion_trial_index`
  - Ui label: champion trial (the features terminal)
  - Never: incumbent, current best; a champion moved inside a family
- the move direction — `forward` for a move that grows the state, `backward` for one that shrinks it; under the asset's noise sigma both clear one gate, and only a calibration run keeps a `backward` move that is no worse

  - Never: add / drop, greedy, step; a ceiling or a floor on the count of columns

- the asset's noise sigma — the standard deviation of one evaluation's path CAGR, measured once off the ledgers of the asset's calibration searches and drafted into its profile by a decision; absent on the calibration run that measures it

- the gate's noise margin — k(n) times the asset's noise sigma, the path-CAGR gain a move must exceed: k(n) the multiple at which the best of n candidates, each scored with noise of its own, beats a parent that carries its own by chance at the rate `GATE_THRESHOLD_FALSE_EXCEEDANCE_RATE`; n the candidates of a pass, the points a pass's studies drew, or every state a serpentine search scored for its proposal
  - Code: `gate_threshold()`, `gate_threshold_multiple()`, `false_exceedance_rate()`, `GATE_THRESHOLD_FALSE_EXCEEDANCE_RATE`, `GATE_THRESHOLD_QUADRATURE_NODE_COUNT`, `GATE_THRESHOLD_BISECTION_BRACKET_MULTIPLES`, `GATE_THRESHOLD_BISECTION_ITERATION_COUNT`

- the inputs of the serpentine search — what it was run under, recorded in its state and compared by equality on the next turn: equal, it resumes; different, it starts again

  - Artifact key: `inputs` with `research_window` (`start_utc`, `end_utc`, `seed`, `warmup_top_timeframe_bars`), `best_params`, `catalogue_columns_by_timeframe`, `active_columns_by_timeframe`, `active_barriers`, `profile`, `selection`
  - Never: fingerprint, hash, checksum; a selection left out of it, which would resume one experiment's trials under another's rules
- current inputs — a recorded serpentine search's inputs that are still the asset's own
  - Code: `serpentine_search_block()` in `module_features/status.py`

- the trial objective — the CAGR of the validation path at the threshold the selection rule picks; none for a pruned trial

- the HPO objective value at the chosen point, named for what it is
  - Code: `OBJECTIVE_KEY` in `module_ml/hpo.py`

  - Never: best_value, score; one key that holds two different quantities
- the trial gate — one gate, read fold by fold: the thresholds at which every fold evaluated so far clears the trade floor and beats the champion's Calmar; the set only shrinks as folds are added, so nothing admissible is discarded
  - Code: `admissible_thresholds()`, `optuna.TrialPruned`
  - Never: a pruner that compares folds as if they were epochs; a gate on a fold's realised value rather than on what it could still reach

  - Code: `hyperparameter_search_result`
  - Artifact key: `hyperparameter_search_result` (a section of the parameters file, a block of ml_status.json)
  - Ui label: HPO
  - Never: a second name for the same block
- the chosen point — the closed set of hyper-parameters a study draws, in xgboost's own spelling
  - Code: the keys of `HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH_SPACE` (a CONFIGURABLES record), `module_ml/config.py` — the one definition the study and the parameters file derive from
  - Artifact key: `best_params`: `alpha`, `colsample_bytree`, `eta`, `lambda`, `max_depth`, `min_child_weight`, `num_boost_round`, `subsample`
  - Ui label: depth, eta, min child, subsample, colsample, lambda, alpha, rounds — the HPO table's columns
  - Never: a project synonym for an xgboost parameter; a second name for any of them; registering them one by one
  - External vocabulary: xgboost
- the frozen constants — what the experiment fixes before any search starts and no search moves
  - Code: every CONFIGURABLES record whose `experiment_identity` is true but `START_BY_COORDINATE_DEFAULT`, frozen as a default alone — the serpentine search moves that geometry and a promotion writes it; beside the records the constants of the method: `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` and the `WARMUP_TOP_TIMEFRAME_BARS` it sets, `XGBOOST_FIXED_PARAMETERS`, `MINUTES_PER_YEAR`
  - Artifact key: `experiment_identity` of a record in `configurables` of `features_status.json` and `ml_status.json`
  - Ui label: the CONFIGURABLES frames of the Features and ML Research tabs, `experiment identity` = yes
  - Never: a searched parameter among them; a value changed without a commit that says so; a feature parameter copied out of the catalogue into a named constant; `ATR_WILDER_SMOOTHING_PERIOD_BARS`; `LABEL_BARRIER_TRUE_RANGE_MULTIPLIER`, `LABEL_HORIZON`, `LABEL_HORIZON_MINUTES` — names no code carries
- the Sharpe — annualised Sharpe of the equity path sampled at decision-bar closes, reported beside the objective and never selected on
  - Code: `sharpe`, `sharpe_annualised()`
  - Artifact key: `sharpe`
  - Ui label: Sharpe
  - Never: return/risk; a deflated Sharpe ratio of nested trials
  - External vocabulary: finance (Sharpe ratio)
- the selection population — the grid points that cleared the trade floor in every validation fold, and the spread of the objective over them; `null` when nothing qualified
  - Code: `entry_edge_threshold_selection()`, `SELECTION_EXPOSURE_KEYS`
  - Artifact key: `cleared_point_count`, `median_cagr_over_cleared`, `max_cagr_over_cleared`
  - Ui label: `grid points cleared`, `median CAGR over cleared` in the strategy table; `chosen out of` on the asset page
  - Never: a corrected or deflated score; a p-value; a confidence interval — the correction is the reader's and cannot be made without these
- the score the chosen entry edge threshold stood at, named for what it is under the objective the experiment froze
  - Code: `SELECTION_SCORE_KEY`, `selection_score()` in `module_ml/strategy.py`
  - Artifact key: `selection_score_cagr_validation_path`
  - Ui label: selection score; `degradation` for the final holdout's CAGR minus the validation path's — presentation arithmetic
  - Never: one key that holds two different quantities; a score whose name does not say what it measures
- CAGR — the compound annual growth rate of an equity path that started at E₀ = 1, over its own length in minutes, on a calendar year, 24/7
  - Code: `validation.cagr()`, `MINUTES_PER_YEAR`
  - Artifact key: `cagr`
  - Ui label: CAGR
  - Never: annualised return, APY, growth; a year of trading days
  - External vocabulary: finance (compound annual growth rate)
- the Calmar ratio — growth per unit of maximum drawdown, the quantity the gate compares fold by fold, the fold being the unit of robustness
  - Code: `validation.calmar()`
  - Artifact key: `calmar`
  - Ui label: Calmar
  - Never: return/risk, MAR; a Calmar of a fold with no trade in it
  - External vocabulary: finance (Calmar ratio)
- the profit factor — gross profit over gross loss of a population of trades; null where nothing was lost, as a hit rate with no trade
  - Code: `validation.profit_factor()`
  - Artifact key: `profit_factor`
  - Ui label: PF
  - Never: win/loss ratio; a profit factor of one trade
  - External vocabulary: finance (profit factor)
- the validation path — F2, F3 and F4 chained into one walk-forward equity, each fold's 1m curve scaled by what the folds before it settled at
  - Code: `strategy.validation_path_block()`, `strategy.validation_path_cagr()`
  - Artifact key: `validation_path` with `cagr`, `max_drawdown`, `calmar`, `profit_factor`, `trade_count`
  - Ui label: validation path; `path CAGR`, `path Calmar`, `path maxDD`, `path PF` in the tables
  - Never: a mean over folds; an equity curve stitched without rescaling; a path that crosses into the final holdout
- the maximum drawdown — the maximum drawdown of the 1m equity path, the starting capital included
  - Code: `max_drawdown`
  - Artifact key: `max_drawdown`
  - Ui label: maxDD
  - Never: DD
  - External vocabulary: finance (maximum drawdown)
- the exposure — share of the fold spent in a position
  - Code: `exposure`
  - Artifact key: `exposure`
  - Ui label: exposure
  - Never: utilisation
- the hit rate — share of a fold's trades that ended positive
  - Code: `hit_rate`
  - Artifact key: `hit_rate`
  - Ui label: hit; hit rate (the asset's STRATEGY frame)
  - Never: win rate
- the average trade return — mean cost-adjusted return of a trade
  - Code: `average_trade_return`
  - Artifact key: `average_trade_return`
  - Ui label: avg trade
  - Never: expectancy, `avg_trade_ret`
- the final equity — equity at the end of the fold, starting from E₀ = 1
  - Code: `final_equity`
  - Artifact key: `final_equity`
  - Ui label: final equity
  - Never: PnL
- the gain importance — total gain per feature column of a validation fold's booster, zero for a column its trees never split on
  - Code: `gain_importance()`
  - Artifact key: `gain_importance` under `validation_importance.fold_<n>`
  - Ui label: gain
  - Never: importance (bare), weight, the final-holdout booster's gain
  - External vocabulary: xgboost (`total_gain`)
- mean |SHAP| importance — the mean absolute SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) value per feature column of a validation fold's booster, over its scoring rows and the three classes, in margin space, unweighted
  - Code: `mean_abs_shap_importance()`
  - Artifact key: `mean_abs_shap_importance`
  - Ui label: mean |SHAP|
  - Never: `shap` as a key; SHAP importance (a method, not a quantity)
  - External vocabulary: SHAP (xgboost's `pred_contribs`)
- the two importances of every validation booster, the block the page takes its cross-fold means from
